plain.li: Right. Somebody wake up the ones at the back, and we'll begin.
Council's in session; somebody find a chair for the old ones.
We've a few proposals to get through, one at a time, please.
[evening] One last question before bed, and it's what we work on next.
[afterraid] We need to talk about what happened, and what we do now.
[winter] Long nights ahead, so let's spend this one planning.
[tribal|medieval] The fire's lit, so whoever has something to say, say it.
Most of us are here, and that'll do, so let's start.
We've all got work waiting, so let's be quick about it.

warm.li: Thanks for coming, and let's hear each other out before we vote.
Good to see you all; sit wherever you like.
You'll all get your turn to speak tonight, I promise.

blunt.li: Keep it short, say your piece and sit down.

cheerful.li: Welcome, welcome, and mind the loose board by the door!
Here we all are again, so who's got a good idea for us?
Somebody pass the bread around, it's meeting time!

gloomy.li: Let's get this over with before something else goes wrong.
Another meeting, and we're all still alive for it.
Let's settle on a plan before we all lose heart.

cold.li: Let's begin. I'll hear each proposal once.
I've read the proposals already, and I hope the rest of you have.
Sit. We'll go through the proposals in order.

plain.li: I'm with {OTHER_nameDef} on "{AMBITION}"; it makes sense.
My vote goes to "{AMBITION}", because we need it.
Say what you like about {OTHER_nameDef}, the idea's sound.
If we're doing anything this season, let it be "{AMBITION}".
[afterraid] After that raid, I'm voting for "{AMBITION}".
[winter] Winter makes the decision for us, I think.
[poor] We can't afford much, but we can afford that.
I'll put my hand up for "{AMBITION}", and my back into it.
We keep saying we'll do this one day, so let's make it this season.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I don't agree on much, but I agree on this.
[winter] Let's have it done before the next winter, at least.
[afterraid] I don't want another day like this one, so "{AMBITION}", yes.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has clearly thought this through, and I'm for it.
I like it. It's good for all of us, not just the loud ones.
{OTHER_nameDef} cares about this colony, so I'll back it.
It would do us all good, so count me in.

blunt.li: Vote for "{AMBITION}" and let's go to bed.
Good idea, so stop arguing and vote.

cheerful.li: I can already picture it finished, so vote yes!
I've been hoping someone would suggest this one!
Yes to "{AMBITION}", and I'll be up early tomorrow to start!

gloomy.li: It might even work; I've seen stranger things work out.
Fine. Better than sitting around waiting for the next disaster.
I suppose it's worth a try, for whatever good it does.
It won't solve all our troubles, but it might solve one.

cold.li: Of the proposals, "{AMBITION}" has the best return on effort.
I vote yes on "{AMBITION}"; it serves the colony's interests.
The numbers favor it, so yes.

plain.li: With what materials, exactly, are we doing "{AMBITION}"?
All that work, and I bet {OTHER_nameDef} won't lift a finger of it.
Nice idea. Wrong season.
[poor] We can barely feed ourselves and {OTHER_nameDef} wants "{AMBITION}".
[afterraid] We just got shot at and we're talking about "{AMBITION}"?
[winter] Ask me again when I can feel my toes.
We said that last time, and look how that went.
Can we finish the last thing before we start a new one?
I'm not against "{AMBITION}", only against doing it now.

warm.li: I don't want to dismiss it, but are we sure it's the most important thing?
It's a fine idea, but people need rest first.
I'd rather we looked after the ones who are struggling before we start on anything new.

blunt.li: That's the dumbest thing I've heard since the last meeting.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants a lot of things, and most of them are stupid.

cheerful.li: I love the energy, {OTHER_nameDef}, but I can't vote for this one!
Not this one, {OTHER_nameDef}, but ask me again next season!
Ha! No. But I like your spirit.

gloomy.li: We'll get halfway through it, and then the next raid will come.
We don't have the hands for it, and we never have.
It'll go wrong the way the last one did.

cold.li: The cost outweighs the benefit, so vote it down.
I see no return on it this season.
The proposal is poorly planned, and I vote no.

plain.li: I left the stew on the fire, so are we nearly done?
Pass that pemmican over, would you?
Can we vote on whoever keeps tracking mud in?
I had a good point a moment ago, and now it's gone.
[night] Some of us have to be up early.
[rain] At least it's dry in here.
[hot] Can somebody open a door, any door?
[cold] Move in closer, all of you, it's freezing.
[large] With this many of us, only whoever holds the spoon gets to talk.
[small] There are only a handful of us, and we still can't agree.
[trait:Gourmand] Is there going to be food at these things from now on?
[trait:Pyromaniac] Can we hold the next meeting around a big bonfire?
[trait:Ascetic] We have too much as it is.
[trait:Greedy] And what do I get out of it?
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] We could have built half of it by now, instead of talking.
[child] Can I vote? Why not, that's not fair!
[old] When I was young, the oldest one in the room decided, and that was that.

cheerful.li: Best meeting yet, only one argument so far!
I brought biscuits for everyone, but they're mostly crumbs now!
We should do this every night!

gloomy.li: We'll all be dead before any of this matters.
I've forgotten what we're voting on.

blunt.li: Hurry it up, I've got work waiting.
